title: The Wave That Was Not Water
tiktok_caption:
Twenty one dead in a north-end street, and the killer was warm and brown.
#history #boston #truestory #wtf
style_prefix: documentary evidence photograph, large-format black and white sheet film, deep tonal range, hard flash shadow, waterfront north end of Boston, brick tenements and elevated rail girders, salt-stained granite quay, one signature light: pale winter sun from the south-east across wet cobbles, honest shadows, real surface wear, vertical 9:16 composition, cinematic.

beats.narration: Molasses killed twenty one people. It outran them.
beats.image_prompt: wide shot of a brown wave taller than the tenement doors surging down a cobbled street, a young carter in a soaked wool jacket hauling a child clear, hard midday sun from the south raking his left cheek, sea spray hanging in the air, chipped cobblestones underfoot
beats.motion_prompt: the brown wave surges down the street as the carter hauls the child clear

beats.narration: The tank stood five storeys high on the harbour front, holding two and a half million gallons of molasses.
beats.image_prompt: medium shot of a labourer in his forties, canvas jacket and wool cap, one hand braced on the rail below the rusted riveted steel tank, low winter sun from the west lighting the right side of his face, steam off the harbour water behind him
beats.motion_prompt: the labourer braces against the rail and the steam lifts off the water

beats.narration: Neighbours had complained for years. The seams wept. Children carried home cups of the sweet drips.
beats.image_prompt: detail shot of a weeping steel seam, a gloved hand pressing a rag to the dark residue staining the plate below each rusted rivet, light from above through a gap in the girders
beats.motion_prompt: a bead swells at the seam and falls onto the waiting rag

beats.narration: The company painted the tank brown. The leaks did not stop. They stopped being visible.
beats.image_prompt: low angle of a painter in oilskins reaching up with a loaded brush over a cracked and peeling steel plate, side-lit from the left, his jaw shadowed, brush marks catching the raking light
beats.motion_prompt: the painter reaches up and drags fresh paint across the split

beats.narration: On the fifteenth of January the temperature climbed almost twenty degrees. The molasses began to ferment.
beats.image_prompt: overhead view of a clerk's hands turning a mercury thermometer on a frost-cracked window ledge, condensation beading below it, morning light from the east
beats.motion_prompt: the mercury column climbs and the condensation slides downward

beats.narration: At half past twelve the rivets let go, and witnesses two streets away heard a sound like a machine gun.
beats.image_prompt: aerial view of a broad brown tide spreading across a wrecked waterfront street, splintered timber and a bent lamp standard, figures scattering toward the higher ground, hard midday shadow from the south
beats.motion_prompt: the tide rolls across the street and the figures scatter uphill

beats.narration: The wave stood fifteen feet high. Molasses is heavier than water. It shoves.
beats.image_prompt: interior of a flooded ground-floor room, a woman in a soaked apron kneeling beside a toppled stove, brown residue at chest height on stained wallpaper, daylight through a broken window from the left across her profile
beats.motion_prompt: the woman kneels and drags the stove clear of the residue

beats.narration: The court found the tank was built too thin and never tested. The steel had no margin.
beats.image_prompt: over-the-shoulder view of an inspector in a stiff collar tracing a pencilled thickness figure on a dog-eared engineering drawing, lamp light from directly above, his brow lit and his eyes in shadow
beats.motion_prompt: the inspector's finger points at the circled figure and stops

beats.narration: Crews washed the streets with sea water for weeks. Residents swore the harbour smelled sweet on hot afternoons.
beats.image_prompt: silhouette of a lone watchman on an empty cobbled quay at dusk, faded paint lines and a cracked drain grate, warm sodium lamp light from the north, salt crust in the joints
beats.motion_prompt: a faint sheen ripples in the drain grate as the watchman walks away
